description.value: A single fired round, tracked as one item. On impact: 15-foot burst, 6d6 fire plus 3d6 bludgeoning damage, DC 26 basic Reflex save. A creature that fails is also knocked prone.

cinderfall.incomplete: The stated AoE burst (15-foot, 6d6 fire + 3d6 bludgeoning, DC 26 basic Reflex, prone on failure) has no rule-element or dedicated-field equivalent: this is a type:"ammo" item, and Foundry's ammo schema only modifies a fired weapon's own Strike (damage die/type, traits) -- it has no area, save-DC, or condition-on-fail fields of its own, confirmed against real pf2e's own explosive-ammo pattern (Bomb Launcher, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/bomb-launcher.json, which instead re-fires an alchemical bomb item -- a full weapon/consumable with its own Strike -- through a launcher, rather than modeling the explosion as ammo). No launcher weapon exists anywhere in this corpus's weapon-ranged/ (checked all baseType values in use: heavy-rounds, pistol-rounds, rifle-rounds, shotgun-shells, sling-bullets -- no missiles/mortar-rounds launcher). Modeling this for real would need a new launcher weapon plus an attack/action item carrying its own damage+save, out of scope for a rule-element pass on the ammo card itself.
